records.title: Category and subcategory summaries
records.name: Category and subcategory summaries
records.audience: Human or agent arriving at one part of the manual
records.trigger: Open a category from contents, a breadcrumb or a contextual help pointer
records.proposed_purpose: Explain the category enough to choose the right deeper page.
content: What this category is for, in two or three sentences.
The few terms needed to distinguish its children.
A short relationship sketch where useful: for example QA method → plan/case → bound requirement → attempts/evidence/review.
Links to immediate children with a one-line reason to read each.
Prerequisites or support limits that change the user’s choice.
Related concepts and the next likely action; link exact command help for execution.
records.authority_and_reuse: Author the introduction once in the category landing; generate breadcrumbs and child links from the shared tree. Technical definitions and operation recipes stay in their canonical detail homes. Do not force empty single-child categories.
records.proposal_status: Proposed documentation shape, not a new runtime subsystem
plan_notes: Documentation organization proposal: outside current locked item details

records.name: Full manual contents / first lookup index
records.audience: Humans browsing the whole product and agents locating canonical knowledge
records.trigger: Full contents link, unfamiliar feature name, or need to find the authoritative topic
records.current: nav.yaml lists 27 public pages while additional public pages exist; the new concept tree is a proposal, not existing article coverage.
records.proposed_purpose: Make every supported subject discoverable with exactly one canonical home.
content: The complete agreed chapter/topic/subtopic tree.
One short category description, where it helps distinguish similar names.
Links to canonical pages and sideways references for concepts used elsewhere.
Separate user, administrator and contributor areas.
Clear current versus historical/proposed status; no link should imply an unwritten proposal is shipped behavior.
records.authority_and_reuse: Generate the full contents from the maintained manual navigation/parent metadata. The website sidebar, installed Markdown index/breadcrumbs and this full contents view are projections of that one structure; hand-author only category descriptions and intentional related/next links.

records.proposal_status: Proposed generated view; final file name can follow the agreed navigation contract
plan_notes: Documentation organization proposal: outside both locked plans

records.title: Public documentation landing: upyoke.com/docs
records.name: Public documentation landing: upyoke.com/docs
records.audience: Visitors, new users, returning operators and agents following a docs link
records.scope: Global/static; no assumed signed-in account or current project
records.trigger: Open /docs or the workbench Docs link
records.current: /docs renders docs/public/index.md, currently What Yoke is, beside a flat Start/Operate/Reference sidebar. There is no separate documentation landing/search/version presentation in that shell.
records.proposed_purpose: Help a reader choose where to read, without making them read the manual first.
content: A brief welcome naming this as the Yoke manual.
Prominent links: Understand Yoke, Install or connect, Work in an existing project.
Separate links: Full contents, Command reference, Fix a problem.
Visible documentation release identity and how to compare it with yoke --version.
A small route for administrators and contributors, kept accessible without occupying beginner guidance.
records.authority_and_reuse: Keep landing copy in the shared public corpus (root index.md is a suitable existing home). Platform supplies navigation/search/version chrome. Derive chapter links and labels from the maintained navigation tree; do not maintain a second website-only contents list.
records.distinct_from: Overview teaches the operating model; contents lists the complete hierarchy; this page routes readers to them.
records.proposal_status: Proposed future landing using the existing public corpus → installed docs → pinned-wheel website pipeline
plan_notes: Documentation organization proposal: outside current locked item details

records.title: First overview document: Understand Yoke
records.name: First overview document: Understand Yoke
records.audience: Humans learning the product and agents needing a compact product model
records.scope: Global/static; applies across local, self-hosted and hosted modes
records.trigger: First intentional read after the docs landing, help link or setup handoff
records.current: The existing index.md and concepts.md split introductory material and contain some duplicated or stale workflow/navigation descriptions.
records.proposed_purpose: Give the minimum model needed to make a good first request.
content: Humans choose outcomes and make required decisions; agents and deterministic workers execute and retain evidence.
A universe holds shared state; projects own their work; a machine runs sessions against that state.
A current plan states near-term intent; items make work concrete; workflows determine how that work proceeds.
Use an agent for planning/execution, the workbench for progress/decisions, and CLI help for exact commands.
Direct work, document-led work and decomposed work are choices based on the task; the agent can recommend the workflow.
Steering staffs work from a strategy document; selecting one ready item is a separate action.
Verification proves an outcome; QA review and deployment approval are different decisions; merge-only work need not deploy.
A new project and a mature project both fit: adopt existing direction, tests and delivery before adding new machinery.
Local reachability, optional GitHub integration and projectless coordination are boundaries worth knowing; deeper details remain linked.
records.authority_and_reuse: Consolidate introductory prose into one canonical overview, reusing concepts.md if practical. Keep deep definitions in their canonical chapters and link them. Do not include the exhaustive TOC, command table or Yoke-maintainer production policy.
records.distinct_from: This is authored explanation with one compact work-cycle picture if helpful, not a navigation catalog or setup wizard.
records.proposal_status: Proposed consolidation and correction of existing introductory docs

records.title: Project overview / initial project handoff
records.name: Project overview / initial project handoff
records.audience: Human adopting or opening a project; agent consuming the same facts
records.scope: One explicitly identified project, in its actual checkout for item work
records.trigger: Project onboarding handoff, first project visit, or explicit request for an overview
records.current: Projects has a roster and settings detail, while Strategy/Frontier/Shipping carry substantive work. No current combined Overview route exists.
records.proposed_purpose: Explain this project’s operating model and the next useful action, without replaying global setup.
content: Which universe, project and checkout this is.
What the project is for and the accepted current plan; identify templates or missing direction honestly.
What existing work is being adopted and what remains outside the agreed intake.
How this project builds, tests and ships; whether it is merge-only or has configured delivery.
Where its project guidance lives and which workflow/policies the next item actually uses.
How to act: ask the agent to plan or run work; use Strategy, Frontier, Sessions and Inbox to inspect or decide.
One useful next step, with deeper setup offered only when the task needs it.
records.authority_and_reuse: Project facts come from current project/strategy/workflow/capability/checklist reads. An agent can render the concise handoff; a compact Projects detail/onboarding card can link the same facts. Do not create a new monolithic dashboard Overview or copy this snapshot into permanent policy prose.
records.proposal_status: Proposed shared fact projection and human rendering; exact placement remains reviewable
